The §6Large Solar Overpressure Array§r moves the boiler room into the sky: no fuel, just weather — the stronger the sun, the harder it steams, and the nickel tier emits superheated outright.

It has the same §6overpressure§r mechanic: push heat up and output climbs; shade one block on top and the sunlight ratio drops accordingly. The controller slot also takes §3solar boilers§r as boosters — the four from the reward slot straight in.

Keep a reservoir: at night and in the rain, the sun clocks out.

§cSunlight is free, but it keeps office hours.§r
